property.name: buttons
property.label: Buttons (JSON)
property.description: JSON array of button objects with label, value, icon, and iconPosition properties

property.name: mode
property.label: Mode
property.description: Mode of the button bar: Navigation or Selection

property.name: barLabel
property.label: Button Bar Label
property.description: Label displayed above the button bar

property.name: barLabelStyle
property.label: CSS for Bar Label
property.description: CSS styling for the bar label, e.g., 'font-size: 16px; color: blue;'

property.name: buttonLabelStyle
property.label: CSS for Button Label
property.description: CSS styling for button labels, e.g., 'font-size: 14px; color: red;'

property.name: selectedValue
property.label: Selected Button Value
property.description: Outputs the value of the selected button (single selection)

property.name: selectedValues
property.label: Selected Button Values
property.description: Outputs the values of the selected buttons (multi-selection)
